subject: Next steps: Procurement & Security requirements for Acme
messages:
From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: Procurement & Security requirements for Acme

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo and the quick sync earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can move procurement: 

- Pilot scope: 3 dev seats for internal testing + access to the hosted API for 30 days.
- Commercial path: our procurement team needs to confirm whether we can run the pilot on corporate card or if a PO is required. For long-term production (Dedicated), we will need a PO/contract. Can you confirm what payment methods you accept for pilot vs production?
- Security/compliance: our IT Security asked about SOC 2 Type II report, the DPA, and whether you can complete our standard security questionnaire (we usually send acme-security-questionnaire.docx).
- Marketplace: procurement asked if Redwood is available on the AWS Marketplace (that would accelerate approvals).

Can you send the SOC2 evidence (redacted ok), your standard DPA, and a short note on procurement options & expected timeline? I can intro procurement+itsec once we have the docs.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Procurement once you confirm.

Jordan
Jordan Matthews
Product Manager, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: Procurement & Security requirements for Acme

Hi Jordan —

Great to meet — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Payment methods: For pilots we accept corporate card or invoice (credit-card easiest to start). For production / Dedicated capacity we typically move to a PO and formal contract with Net-30 terms (we can be flexible on term length; we’ll note this for Neha).
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace in select regions; we’re in process of expanding our listing to include usage-based offers. I’ll confirm exact timing for Acme.
- SOC 2 & DPA: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and our standard DPA. I’m attaching a copy of our quick SAQ/overview and will have Neha follow up with the formal DPA and SOW template.
- Security questionnaire: happy to complete Acme's questionnaire or have your team complete our SAQ first to triage items. If your itsec prefers the full questionnaire, please send it and we’ll route to our security team.

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached a short SAQ summary now (see attachment in follow-up).
2) Neha will send the DPA, the Draft SOW and procurement checklist, and confirm Marketplace status.
3) Jordan to introduce procurement@acme.com and itsec@acme.com so we can close the documentation loop.

Putting Neha on copy to drive the contract/procurement path.

Best,

Subject: Re: Next steps: Procurement & Security requirements for Acme

Hi Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks — looping in Vivek for any technical/arch questions. Jordan, a few items from procurement/legal/security perspective so we can scope the right path quickly: 

1) Attachments: I’ve attached our Redwood_SAQ.pdf (high-level self-assessment) and a Draft_SOW_v1.docx template for the pilot. We will also provide the standard DPA via DocuSign once terms are agreed.
2) SOC 2: We can provide the redacted SOC 2 Type II report (security section redactions are common). Please confirm if Acme requires the full report or redacted; if the full report is required, we typically require an NDA/TPA before sharing certain vendor artifacts.
3) Questionnaire workflow: If your IT Security prefers, they can send the completed questionnaire and our security team will respond directly (typical turnaround 3-5 business days). Alternatively, your team can start with our SAQ to triage high-level items.
4) Payment & procurement: Pilot can proceed on corporate card or simple invoice (we’ll accept card to speed onboarding). For production Dedicated/committed capacity we require a PO and standard contract. Typical PO/contract terms we see: Net-30, standard indemnities; if you need different payment terms, let us know and we can escalate.
5) Marketplace listing: Redwood is on AWS Marketplace for some SKUs. For procurement teams that require Marketplace procurement, the listing for usage-based offers should be live within the next 4-6 weeks — we’ll share the exact marketplace SKU/URL as soon as it’s published.

Action items for Acme: 
- Please introduce procurement@acme.com and itsec@acme.com to this thread.
- Confirm whether Acme needs the full SOC2 report or redacted copy.
- Share the security questionnaire if you want our team to complete it directly.
- Confirm expected pilot start date (we have slots next week for a quick provisioning).

I will also attach the Draft_SOW_v1 and route the DPA for signature when commercial terms are aligned.

Thanks — Happy to hop on a short call if needed.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Contracts & GTM Ops | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.matthews@acme.com>

Thanks Marissa / Neha — this is helpful. I’ll introduce Procurement and IT Security on this thread by EOD. Quick answers: 

- Procurement: happy to start the pilot on corporate card; for production we will submit a PO (likely Net-30).
- SOC2: IT Security has asked for the redacted report first — they’ll request the full report if needed and will send whatever NDA is necessary.
- Questionnaire: I’m attaching the Acme security questionnaire (acme-security-questionnaire.docx) to this reply for your team to pick up. IT Security will also join the thread once I introduce them.
- Marketplace: procurement would prefer Marketplace but can proceed via card if needed to speed pilot. Please send the marketplace SKU when available.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll introduce procurement@acme.com and itsec@acme.com now.

Best,
Jordan
